fetch_models_dev: fetch the models.dev registry with in-memory and disk caching for offline-first access
get_model_capabilities: get structured capability metadata including vision, tools, reasoning, and context window for a provider model
list_agentic_models: list model IDs suitable for agentic use from a provider filtering out TTS embedding and noise models
get_model_info: get full model metadata including cost modalities capabilities and limits as a ModelInfo dataclass
get_provider_info: get full provider metadata including API URL env vars and model count as a ProviderInfo dataclass
